description: For a skill about to gain XP: the total ranks counted against the cap of 400, whether the cap blocks the award (at the cap with no unlocked skill left to give up a rank), and the most XP the skill can take before any would be lost (limited by its rank ceiling, the free ranks under the cap and the ranks other skills can give up).
inputs: Hand-built player records, one per row; see the case column. The target is Armor unless the case says language (Mirialan). Fillers are Piloting, First Aid, Smithery, Fabrication, Gathering, Leadership, Beast Mastery and Force, in that record order.
rows: at the cap, others at their limit
at the cap, one decayable skill
at the cap, one skill above its limit
at the cap, three decayable skills
at the cap, two skills above their limit
at the cap, one skill 3 ranks above its limit
at the cap, two skills 1 and 2 ranks above their limits
at the cap, a skill at rank zero is not a candidate
one free rank, stored XP already pays for it
